answer: A registry can require each agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared onyx vault and emit a verifiable activity pulse every epoch: the stake is slashed if the same key signs conflicting work or goes silent. A cheap Sybil swarm cannot wander in for free, because every extra identity multiplies the locked capital at risk, while honest agents earn the stake back with interest, so creating ten thousand fake agents costs ten thousand times the bond.
